title: The owner's architect presentation contract persisted: the adopted brief at docs/design, routing from the design-system document and the web rule, a short CLAUDE.md pointer, a path-scoped rule for the drawing and CAD paths, and a design entry in the handoff (D-090 source-079, the brief's first step)
objective: Persist the owner's design brief of 2026-10-09 as the repository's architect presentation contract and route every later session and path to it, so the website and PDF work that follows reads one contract. Instruction files only; no product file changes.
business_reason: The owner's brief asks for this first (its sections 9 and 10), so that the presentation rules survive across sessions and the next sessions build the website and PDF to them.
inputs: project-control/directives/D-090-product-plan-2026-09-28-start-building/source-079-amendment.md (the brief quoted whole; rows R800 to R891)
outputs: routing lines in docs/PREMIUM_PRODUCT_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, .claude/rules/frontend-web.md and CLAUDE.md
a compact design entry in docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md

acceptance_scenarios.expected: a short header gives its origin (the owner's package, its file name and SHA-256), the adoption date 2026-10-09, the directive rows and that later approved changes go into this one file; below it the brief's text is byte-identical to the owner's file (the digest of the body equals 3faa7d1f...).

acceptance_scenarios.case: The design-system document routes to the contract
acceptance_scenarios.expected: its supersession note names the contract and the sections it overrides on conflict (page composition, tokens, typography, status presentation, responsive behavior, visual acceptance) by number; no section or requirement is deleted; the earlier set-aside note stays.

acceptance_scenarios.case: The web rule routes to the contract
acceptance_scenarios.expected: one short line: read the contract before architect-facing website, report or drawing work; its paths frontmatter is unchanged.

acceptance_scenarios.case: A path-scoped rule for the server drawing and CAD paths
acceptance_scenarios.expected: frontmatter paths for services/api/app/drawings/** and services/api/app/cad/**; a short body: read the contract; use the canonical results and geometry; keep the current status meaning; render and inspect the affected screen or PDF output; record the evidence through the existing gate. No skill, hook or watcher.

acceptance_scenarios.case: The CLAUDE.md pointer within the context budget
acceptance_scenarios.expected: CLAUDE.md gains one short pointer to the contract (the brief's suggested wording, shortened); the eager total stays under 10000 tokens because one PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE bullet moves unchanged to docs/WORKING_KNOWLEDGE.md (Tier 2) with a one-line pointer left; the budget check passes.

a compact entry: the contract path and its commit; the last surface or export checked (none yet in the product; the one-off test PDF in the session folder); remaining checks not run; the questions file and the open question ids; the next visible action and the hold that applies (screen files wait for wave 19).

acceptance_scenarios.input: git diff of the task's commit
acceptance_scenarios.expected: only the allowed paths change; no product, contract, tool or test file; the validator and the lane-path coverage pass.

risks: The always-loaded budget has about 21 tokens left: the pointer needs room made first (S5).
Writes under .claude/ can be refused by the session's safety check; the owner's words are recorded first (source-079).
path_notes: Producer: the orchestrator (a governance task, as M0-T097). Copy the brief byte for byte from the package file; never retype it. The contract adopts the WHOLE brief; its sample figures stay attributed to the test assembly, as the brief says. Keep every pointer short (CLAUDE.md principle 19 and the brief's section 10). Built on the wave-19 branch beside tasks M5-T146 and M5-T147 (disjoint paths) and merged in the same pull request.
